name: kabuken
description: Financial data from the official EDINET filings of Japanese listed companies, with the source filing for each figure. No stock prices or investment advice.

interface.longDescription: Kabuken gives you financial data on Japanese listed companies. Find a company by name, then get its financial statements, business and geographic segments, filing list and any single figure in a filing. It also shows who owns the company (large-shareholding reports, top shareholders, owner categories and policy holdings) and its officers, officer pay and human-capital metrics such as the ratio of female managers, male childcare leave and the gender pay gap. It also computes a DuPont decomposition of ROE and a Sloan-style accrual ratio from filing figures. You can also compare two to five companies side by side. Data from official EDINET filings, with the source filing for each figure. No stock prices or investment advice. A Kabuken account is required; you sign in with Google.
capabilities: Read financial statements from EDINET filings
Find one figure in a filing step by step
Show top shareholders, owner categories and policy holdings
Show officers, officer pay and human-capital metrics
Break ROE into DuPont components and show cash-flow accruals
Summarize a company's major facilities by country and prefecture
defaultPrompt: Screen Japanese electronics makers by operating margin in their latest annual reports, with each figure's source filing.
What is the gender pay gap at Toyota, and who are its directors?
What were Sony's revenue and operating income in its latest annual report, and which filing are they from?

positive.description: DuPont 3-step ROE decomposition and Sloan-style cash-flow accrual ratio per fiscal year.
positive.prompt: Break down Nintendo's ROE with the DuPont decomposition and show the cash-flow accrual ratio for the last three annual periods.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves Nintendo (7974) to its entity code and calls get_company_financials once with include indicators, dupont and sloan. Shows one row per fiscal year with the doc_id and fiscal year end: net margin, asset turnover, equity multiplier and ROE, then the accrual ratio. States the averaging basis (average of opening and closing balances, or closing only), shows the reported ROE and the difference from it, and names any missing input instead of estimating it. Does not call any figure good or bad and gives no investment advice.

positive.description: Latest annual revenue and operating income, with the source filing.
positive.prompt: What were Sony Group's revenue and operating income in its latest annual report?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves Sony Group Corporation to its entity code, then returns revenue and operating income for the latest annual period from its EDINET filing. State the fiscal period and cite the source EDINET filing by its doc_id for every figure. Does not estimate any figure or add a stock price, market cap or valuation ratio.

positive.description: Business and geographic segment breakdown from one filing.
positive.prompt: Show Honda Motor's revenue by business segment from its latest annual securities report.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves Honda Motor Co., Ltd., picks its most recent annual securities report from the filing list, and returns the segment figures grouped by axis with member labels. State the fiscal period and cite the source EDINET filing by its doc_id for every figure. Keeps the EDINET Taxonomy notice that the tool returns.

positive.description: Major shareholders of a listed company.
positive.prompt: Who are the major shareholders of Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group to its entity code and returns the processed large-shareholding reports (大量保有報告書) filed for it, with each holder, its holding ratio and the reporting date (e.g. BlackRock Japan and co-filers 7.03% reported 2025-03-19; Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Asset Management and co-filer 4.89% reported 2025-09-19). Cites the source EDINET filing by its doc_id. Does not give investment advice.

positive.description: Peer comparison of two to five companies from their latest annual reports.
positive.prompt: Compare Toyota Motor and Honda Motor on revenue, operating income, net income and total assets.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves both companies to entity codes (Toyota is E02144), calls compare_companies once, and shows a table with one column per company and the period-end date of each, because fiscal year-ends can differ. Cites the source EDINET filing by its doc_id for each company. A missing metric is shown with its omission reason, not a guessed number. No ranking by price-based metrics. Honda reports an operating loss and a net loss for the fiscal year to March 2026 (EV-related write-downs); Kabuken shows the filed values (e.g. operating profit −¥414,346 million, profit attributable to owners −¥423,941 million, filing S100YDD9).

negative.description: Stock prices are out of scope. Kabuken has filing data only, no market data.
negative.prompt: What is Toyota's stock price today?
negative.expected_behavior: Kabuken is not called, or the assistant explains that Kabuken has no stock price or market data and does not invent a price.

negative.description: Investment advice is out of scope.
negative.prompt: Should I buy or sell Sony shares right now?
negative.expected_behavior: Kabuken is not called for a recommendation. The assistant does not give buy or sell advice and can offer reported figures from Sony's filings instead.

negative.description: Companies outside Japan's EDINET system are not covered.
negative.prompt: What was Apple's revenue last year?
negative.expected_behavior: Kabuken is not called, or the assistant explains that Kabuken covers only Japanese companies that file on EDINET and has no data for Apple. No figure is invented.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It only reads published filing data.

publication.release_notes: Kabuken 2.3.0: get_company_financials adds DuPont 3-step ROE and Sloan-style cash-flow accrual ratio per fiscal year, with inputs, averaging basis and the reported ROE check. New skill: analysis-models. Shareholders: one row per filer with the change since the previous report. See the What's new page: https://kabuken.intellics.ai/docs/en/whats-new/

ja-JP.subtitle: 日本の上場企業の開示データ
ja-JP.description:
Kabuken（カブケン）は、日本の上場企業の財務データを提供します。会社名で企業を検索し、財務諸表、事業別・地域別のセグメント情報、提出書類の一覧、提出書類の中の個別の数値を取得できます。大量保有報告書、大株主の状況、所有者別状況、政策保有株式から企業の株主構成を示し、役員、役員報酬、女性管理職比率・男性育休取得率・男女の賃金の差異などの人的資本の指標も表示します。提出書類の数値からROEのデュポン分解とSloan型のアクルーアル比率も算出します。2社から5社までを並べて比較することもできます。データはEDINETの公式な提出書類に基づき、各数値には出典となる書類を示します。株価や投資助言は提供しません。Kabukenのアカウントが必要です（Googleでサインイン）。

主な機能:
・日本の上場企業を検索
・EDINET提出書類から財務諸表を表示
・提出書類の中の数値を段階的に検索
・セグメント別の内訳を表示
・大株主、所有者別状況、政策保有株式を表示
・役員、役員報酬、人的資本の指標を表示
・複数の企業を並べて比較
・企業の提出書類を一覧表示
・主要な設備の所在国と都道府県を集計

質問の例:
・電機メーカーを最新の有価証券報告書の営業利益率でスクリーニングして、各数値の出典書類も示して
・トヨタの男女の賃金の差異と取締役の一覧は？
・ソニーグループの最新の有価証券報告書の売上高と営業利益と、その出典書類は？
